talkingPoints.text: moisturizing, plump dewy glow, color lasts through 24h

benefits.text: BBIA Eau Glow Cushion is a semi-glow cushion with SPF40 PA+++ sun protection that protects the skin from the harmful effects of UV rays. It contains up to 65% moisturizing essence, helping maintain moisture throughout the day and giving the skin a natural dewy glow. Color lasts up to 24 hours without causing skin irritation. The product has received VEGAN certification from France and is suitable for all skin tones.

howToUse.text:
Use the puff included in the cushion case to pick up an appropriate amount of product and pat evenly onto the face.
For areas that need extra coverage, a concealer can be used alongside for smooth, perfect skin.

safety.text:
For external use only; do not use on damaged skin
Discontinue use if signs of irritation appear, and keep out of reach of children.

positioning.text: Semi-glow cushion for a naturally dewy base, with moisturizing and sun protection, suited to everyday makeup.

sellingPoints.text: SPF40 PA+++; contains 65% moisturizing essence; color lasts up to 24h.

texture.text: Thin, moist base cushion that blends into the skin, with a juicy, watery feel.

finish.text: Semi-glow / natural dewy glow / moist and smooth.

claimDisclaimers.text: Do not say “non-irritating” in an absolute sense. Do not claim skin repair, dry-skin treatment, or sun protection that replaces dedicated sunscreen.
